sophie: Morning everyone — quick Day 5 async check-in. Please reply with: 1) what you did yesterday 2) blockers 3) plan for today

alex: 1) finished README walkthrough + ran local dev server
2) blocked by missing write access to repo 'infra-config'
3) today: pair with @kevin on the API auth flow

jamal: 1) completed identity docs and SSO setup steps
2) laptop still in provisioning (no admin creds yet) — can't install CUDA drivers :disappointed:
3) today: follow up with IT ticket, start infra onboarding once laptop arrives

maria: IT: Hi @jamal — ticket #4521 created, ETA for laptop handoff is ~Tue 3pm PT, will update if earlier. Can you confirm shipping address in the HR form?

jamal: confirmed address in HR form — thanks @maria :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: Welcome @alex and @jamal! Reminder: complete security training by EOD Friday. https://intra.redwood.ai/training/security

kevin: @alex I added you to infra-config repo (team: eng-core). Try again and ping if still denied.

alex: got it, can clone now. thanks @kevin :tada:

sophie: great progress. @jamal — once laptop is handed off, ping me and I'll schedule a 1:1 to get you on the model-serving quickstart. Also tagging @maria to confirm VM access for both new hires.

maria: working on a jumpbox for them. Expect IAM role + SSH key config by EOD today.

jamal: thanks — will be online around 4pm PT to test SSH.

sophie: blockers summary: alex repo access resolved; jamal waiting on laptop + SSH; security training pending for both. If anything urgent, DM me. Optional: post screenshots if you hit errors during setup.

alex: small question — which slack channel for infra alerts? should I join eng-infra and eng-runtime?

kevin: yes, join both. eng-oncall only if you need rota access.

alex: joining now. thanks!

sophie: end of thread — nice work today :sparkles:
